blocks.h2: When a Clog Needs a Plumber
blocks.body: Call when a plunger doesn't solve it, when the same drain is slow again within a few weeks or when you notice a sewer smell. Then look at how many drains are affected. A single slow fixture usually has a clog nearby. When the floor drain rises on laundry day, or a toilet gurgles while the tub drains, the main line is blocked and needs [sewer rodding](/hinsdale/sewer-rodding).

img.alt: Illustration of common signs a drain needs professional cleaning

bodies: Hair and soap in bathroom drains, grease in the kitchen and lint in the laundry cause most clogs. We clear them with equipment sized for the pipe and show you what was causing the slowdown.

Older Hinsdale homes often still have galvanized and cast iron drains inside the walls. Their rough interiors catch debris, so clogs come back faster. If one drain keeps clogging, we'll camera it and tell you whether it needs [hydro jetting](/hinsdale/hydro-jetting) or a section replaced.
Grease is the root of most kitchen clogs. It hardens on the pipe walls and catches food and soap until the sink stops draining.

If both bowls fill or the dishwasher drains into the sink, the clog is past the trap. We clear it back to the stack. Disposal involved? See [garbage disposal repair](/hinsdale/garbage-disposal-installation-repair).

blocks.h2: Why Drains Clog in Hinsdale Homes
blocks.intro: Hinsdale's homes range from the 1800s to new construction, and drain problems follow their age.

items.body: A beautifully remodeled bath can still drain through the original pipe.
Islands and prep sinks mean long horizontal runs where grease settles.
Several slow drains at once usually mean the main is blocked. See [sewer drain clearing](#sewer-drain-clearing).

bodies: When the whole house drains slowly or water appears at the floor drain, the main sewer drain is blocked. Clearing it takes equipment that can reach from the cleanout all the way to the village main.

We clear the line and run a camera so you see the cause. Under older homes, it's usually roots in clay. Under newer ones, it's more often grease or wipes. Repeat clogs get a plan: [sewer rodding](/hinsdale/sewer-rodding), [hydro jetting](/hinsdale/hydro-jetting) or a [sewer repair](/hinsdale/sewer-repair).

blocks.h2: Drain Cleaning Questions From Hinsdale Homeowners

items.q: Do you clear drains on nights and weekends?
items.answer: Yes. If a drain backs up at night or over a weekend, call us and we'll get a plumber to you as soon as we can.

items.q: Why does my older home clog so often?
items.preview: Old pipe is rough inside and catches debris.
items.answer: Old galvanized and cast iron drains narrow and roughen over time, so they catch hair and grease faster. Jetting or replacing the worst section helps.

items.q: Is it one drain or the main line?
items.preview: One fixture is local. Several, or the floor drain, is the main.
items.answer: If only one fixture is slow, the clog is close to it. If several are slow or the floor drain backs up, it's the main line.
Yes. We cover floors along our path and around the work area and clean up before we leave.
